source.institution: Autoridad Nacional del Agua - Direccion de Calidad y Evaluacion de Recursos Hidricos
source.title: Estudio Hidrologico de la Unidad Hidrografica Lurin
source.purpose: ordenamiento y gestion de los recursos hidricos

basin_context.interpretation: The Lurin system is hydraulically managed and includes diversions and intake infrastructure. Historical station flow cannot be transferred to downstream impact state without considering reach, abstractions, timing, geometry and receiving-channel conditions.

limitations: This evidence is basin/system context and not a dated event outcome record.
Reported diversion capacities or rates are not event-day abstraction measurements.
The study does not validate the 2017-03-14 Antapucro-to-Pachacamac travel time for IRFEN.
No design-flow or return-period value from this study may be promoted to an operational IRFEN threshold.
